title: Active Workspace Count
prompt: A TypeScript dashboard tracks active workspaces. Write a typed function that returns how many items have active set to true.

explanation.beginner:
Example: activeWorkspaceCount([{"id":"1","active":true},{"id":"2","active":false}]) produces 1. The result must follow this precise rule: A TypeScript dashboard tracks active workspaces. Write a typed function that returns how many items have active set to true. Work with one argument at a time and distinguish the values that select a branch from the values returned by that branch.

Compare “returns zero when none are active”: input [[{"id":"1","active":false}]] produces 0. Explain which rule causes the difference before writing code.
explanation.junior:
The result must follow this precise rule: A TypeScript dashboard tracks active workspaces. Write a typed function that returns how many items have active set to true. Work with one argument at a time and distinguish the values that select a branch from the values returned by that branch.
